assistant:
At **16:30 on 6 January**, Bus_29 was at **0.965 p.u.**—within the **0.950–1.050 p.u.** limits, but only **0.015 p.u. above the lower limit**. At the comfortable-margin comparison point, **05:15**, it was **0.982 p.u.**

The voltage fell by **0.016 p.u.** between those moments. The main reason was higher demand near Bus_29: demand at Bus_28 and Bus_29 rose from **8.76 MW to 11.15 MW**, accounting for **73.6%** of the fall. Higher demand elsewhere rose from **182.19 MW to 231.85 MW**, accounting for the remaining **26.4%**. The investigation found no suspicious measured changes; combined output from the five generators was nearly unchanged and was ruled out as a material cause.

As a counterfactual, undoing just the increase in nearby demand would put Bus_29 at **0.977 p.u.** at 16:30. The demand explanation also held against the other references checked.

📋 Data source: measurements
